acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata, lockfile, and current release/versioning guidance identify v0.2.75 while retaining v0.2.74 as the immediately preceding public baseline.
Release CI produces the identity-bound five-target artifact and supply-chain receipt set for v0.2.75.
Public adopter and N-1 acceptance use only v0.2.75 downloaded artifacts, prove forbidden-root isolation and temporary-run cleanup, and exercise the same binary against this repository.
The release starts from a synchronized ready default branch and changes no Runtime behavior, object repository, global Agent/MCP configuration, failed-tag history, or unrelated evidence.
The three reference-parity pages register WI-574 with its bounded release scope and preserve the release documentation traceability.
Any release or adopter failure preserves immutable release truth, records the failure receipt, and never falls back to a source checkout, workspace binary, or moving branch.
goal: Publish a verified v0.2.75 patch release and validate its immutable public installation boundary.
intent: Publish v0.2.75 from the reviewed default branch and validate its immutable public artifacts and adopter installation boundary before continuing the next reference-comparison batch.
outOfScope: Reference-source code or Python/Shell implementation copying
Executing or modifying the object repository; object-repository acceptance is a read-only external handoff
